headline: Second-ranked Tennessee visits struggling Georgia in Week 10
subhead: The Volunteers' dominant form meets a Bulldogs squad fighting to save its season.

xFactor.why: A stout defensive effort is Georgia's only path to slowing Tennessee's explosive offensive rhythm and keeping the game competitive.

keyMatchup: Tennessee's pass rush versus Georgia's offensive line will determine whether the Bulldogs can establish rhythm early or fall behind chasing points.
body: Tennessee arrives in Athens riding genuine momentum after dismantling USC by 25 points, a result that showcased the Volunteers' ability to execute at both ends of the field. The second-ranked team has built its two-loss record through disciplined play and consistent execution, and there's little reason to expect anything different here. Georgia, meanwhile, sits at 5-4 after a narrow three-point win over Arkansas—the kind of result that masks deeper concerns about consistency and execution rather than masking them.

The Bulldogs cannot afford to fall into a early hole against a Tennessee team that thrives when given tempo advantage and field position. Georgia's defensive front will need to generate pressure without blitzing into coverage busts, a balance the staff has struggled to maintain in recent weeks. If Tennessee establishes its run game and forces Georgia into predictable passing situations, the visitors will control the line of scrimmage and likely the game's final score.
